## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and parallel TRA execution

- 2015-07-15: S-1/A attaches form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.5 (Continuing LLC Owners side)
- 2015-08-05: Recapitalization Transactions consummated; TRA effective alongside parallel TRA with Direct TSG Investors
- 2015-08-11: IPO closes

#### TCJA remeasurement

- 2017-Q4: $316.8M gain on TRA-liability remeasurement (across both parallel TRAs) reflecting 35% to 21% federal rate change; consolidated tax benefit arrangement liability $431.4M at year-end 2017

#### Continuing accrual

- 2021-12-31: Consolidated liability peak of $508.7M (current + noncurrent across both TRAs)
- 2025-12-31: Consolidated liability $360.3M

## Explanation

Planet Fitness, Inc. became the obligor under two parallel Tax Receivable Agreements on August 5, 2015 at the consummation of the Recapitalization Transactions preceding its Up-C IPO, of which this is one. This TRA covers the Continuing LLC Owners of Pla-Fit Holdings, paying them 85% of the cash tax savings Planet Fitness realizes from basis adjustments under Sections 732 / 743 / 755 / 1012 arising from exchanges of Pla-Fit Holdings LLC Units for Class A common stock, plus imputed interest. Only the form-of version is on EDGAR (Exhibit 10.5 to the July 15, 2015 S-1/A); no executed counterpart was filed, and subsequent 10-Ks incorporate the form-of by reference. No amendment, restatement, or termination has been filed in over ten years; the Q4 2017 TCJA remeasurement produced a $316.8M consolidated gain across both parallel TRAs without contractual changes, and multiple TSG sell-downs and LLC-Owner exchanges have driven incremental accruals captured under the pre-existing terms. The consolidated tax benefit arrangement liability stood at $360.3M at year-end 2025, down from a 2021 peak of $508.7M but still substantial. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
